title: Executive Pastor
description: What if your next season of leadership helped build a church where discipleship, community, and the life of the Holy Spirit are truly alive? Executive Pastor role at VIVE Culture Church in Kansas City, posted through Shepherd Staff Search Firm.

title: Worship Director

title: Pastor
